name: Felt-tip Market
description: A cheerful storefront drawn in black felt-tip: ink hairlines on paper, flat poster-color bands, chunky sticker objects, one big grotesk. Buttons lift on a hard black shadow. Suits stores, creator tools and marketplaces.

provenance.notes: Derived design language; no name, wordmark, coin mark, copy, sticker artwork, hand-lettered words, characters, mascot or mockups carried over. The proprietary grotesk is replaced with Space Grotesk (fallback DM Sans) and JetBrains Mono, all SIL OFL 1.1. Stickers, badges and vignettes are construction recipes for original subjects. Derived, not observed: form validation, toasts, dialogs, menus, dashboards, loading, error pages, open FAQ rows. Adjusted for accessibility: helper text darkened, error red deepened, focus ring in ink with the pink as an inner band, dark-mode control outlines raised to 3:1.

fonts.fallback: DM Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif
